# T13 synthetic benchmark ledger

Every number is a synthetic benchmark input, not real-wing data. Root chord for the analytic ellipse is derived as 4*b/(pi*AR); the section slope is explicitly selected from the cited theoretical 2*pi helper, not invented or measured.
